title: Marked-anodyne restriction of Cartesian join slices
statement:
Use simplicial sets, standard simplices, degreewise pullbacks from [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], inner fibrations and horn-Cartesian edges from [def-coef-infinity-fibrations], marked simplicial sets and marked-anodyne maps from [lem-coef-marked-anodyne-lifting-calculus], and trivial Kan fibrations from [def-weil-pbc-trivial-kan-fibration]. For simplicial sets $X,Y$, the ordered join has $(X\star Y)_n=X_n\amalg Y_n\amalg\coprod_{a+b+1=n}X_a\times Y_b$, with operators restricting the ordered $X$-block followed by the $Y$-block. Work in any one containing universe. Let $p:E\to B$ be an inner fibration of quasicategories. Let $i:U\hookrightarrow V$ be a marked-anodyne map of marked simplicial sets, and let $q:V\to E$ be a simplicial map carrying every marked edge of $V$ to a $p$-Cartesian edge. Put $q_0=qi$. For any simplicial diagram $a:L\to E$, define the ordered join slice by
$$(E_{/a})_n=\{\sigma:\Delta^n\star L\to E\mid \sigma|_L=a\},$$
with operators given by precomposition with $\Delta(\alpha)\star\operatorname{id}_L$; define $B_{/pa}$ in the same way. Then the simplicial restriction map
$$E_{/q}\longrightarrow E_{/q_0}\times_{B_{/pq_0}}B_{/pq},\qquad \sigma\longmapsto(\sigma|_{\Delta^n\star U},p\sigma),$$
is a trivial Kan fibration. In particular it lifts every simplicial boundary inclusion, including dimension zero, with exact agreement over the displayed target. No existence of Cartesian lifts other than the specified marked images is assumed, and no cardinal bound relative to a smaller universe is placed on $E,B,U,V$.
